references.text: Then the man said: This time it is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. She shall be called woman, for she was taken from man.
Adam named his wife Eve, because she became the mother of all living.
Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Abel became a shepherd of flocks, while Cain worked the soil as a farmer.
Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, for she said: God has given me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.
See, children are a heritage from the Lord, the fruit of the womb is a reward.
By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain. Through it he was declared righteous when God testified to his gifts; and through it he still speaks, even though he is dead.
Not like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own deeds were evil, while his brother's were righteous.
